newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares end mixed on profit-taking, low volume.
newsitem.headline: KL shares end mixed on profit-taking, low volume.

text.p: Malaysian blue-chip shares closed lower on Thursday, pulled down by institutional funds taking profit, dealers and analysts said.
The benchmark Composite Index closed 10.44 points, or 0.93 percent, lower at 1,108.84, while the small-capitalised Second Board index gained 2.89 points to 557.51.
"It was mainly accumulated selling by various brokers. Volume was very thin," said a dealer at a local brokerage house.
